measurementNotes: Small native checkbox/radio glyphs are not the hit area: associated labels were measured separately.
Tall-root element screenshots can reset Playwright mobile touch emulation. Final connection checks restore touch and record pointer evidence.
Initial metrics are observations before the final correction pass, not final conformance assertions.
Full unmasked model-form pixel differences are observational because adapter guidance differs; shared geometry and design contracts are independently asserted.
verificationLimits: Kuery had no connected Kubernetes edge. Setup navigation passed; populated graph, Inventory, Playground and Impact require live data and remain unverified live.
Conditional streams, approvals, runner credentials, deployment convergence, invited members and chart output were reviewed in source/tests where available, not all exercised live.
No enrollment, provisioning, publishing, paid model request or live credential validation was performed by the interaction checks.
This is not a comprehensive screen-reader or WCAG certification.
